rationale.edition: Every changed path in changed_files.txt lives in open-source-owned locations (src/api, src/config, src/core, src/db, web/src, tests/ui-testing). No path is under enterprise/ or o2_enterprise/, and there are no enterprise-only keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) in the changed paths or symbol names, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. The diff is not docs/CI-only and not explicitly opted out (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty; no 'tests-added' label or skip comment was passed). It alters user-facing workflow UI in web/src/components/workflows/** and web/src/plugins/workflows/**, so it is a user-facing behavior change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The workflow editor's Test dialog now exposes a live-dispatch choice (suppressDestinations toggle, a live dispatch warning, and input source labels), and the existing delivery/negative specs were updated to exercise testRunFromEditor({ liveSend: true }) with expectNodeTestPassed — real destination delivery must be verified end-to-end.
rationale.area: Workflows. The bulk of the UI changes are in web/src/components/workflows/**, web/src/plugins/workflows/**, and web/src/components/flow/** (workflow condition builder/destination picker), and sibling E2E specs already exist in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Workflows/.
rationale.group: The Workflows shard (testfolder 'Workflows', actual_folder 'Workflows') in the ci-matrix already runs workflows-negative.spec.js and the delivery spec belongs to the same OSS Workflows group, so the enhanced spec joins the existing 'Workflows' matrix shard.
rationale.existing_tests: Two Playwright E2E specs are changed in the diff: tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Workflows/workflows-delivery.spec.js and workflows-negative.spec.js. They cover the new live-test-dispatch behavior (liveSend: true and the renamed expectNodeTestPassed assertion), so the Architect should enhance/extend these rather than start fresh. The many changed web/src/**/*.spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests and are NOT E2E coverage.
